source.sqlReaderQuery:
SELECT
	ACID
	,REN_SRL_NUM
	,DEPOSIT_PERIOD_MTHS
	,DEPOSIT_PERIOD_DAYS
	,CONVERT(DATETIME2, STUFF(STUFF(STUFF(OPEN_EFFECTIVE_DATE, 9, 0, ' '), 12, 0, ':'), 15, 0, ':')) AS OPEN_EFFECTIVE_DATE
	,CONVERT(DATETIME2, STUFF(STUFF(STUFF(ACCT_OPEN_DATE, 9, 0, ' '), 12, 0, ':'), 15, 0, ':')) AS ACCT_OPEN_DATE
	,CONVERT(DATETIME2, STUFF(STUFF(STUFF(MATURITY_DATE, 9, 0, ' '), 12, 0, ':'), 15, 0, ':')) AS MATURITY_DATE
	,DEPOSIT_AMOUNT
	,MATURITY_AMOUNT
	,RENEWAL_TYPE
	,INT_CR_TBL_CODE
	,OVERDUE_INT_AMT
	,INTEREST_AMOUNT
	,TDS_AMT
	,TRAN_ID
	,CONVERT(DATETIME2, STUFF(STUFF(STUFF(TRAN_DATE, 9, 0, ' '), 12, 0, ':'), 15, 0, ':')) AS TRAN_DATE
	,ADD_AMT
	,ADD_AMT_CRNCY
	,RENEWAL_AMT
	,RENEWAL_AMT_CRNCY
	,RENEWAL_SCHM_CODE
	,RCRE_USER_ID
	,CONVERT(DATETIME2, STUFF(STUFF(STUFF(RCRE_TIME, 9, 0, ' '), 12, 0, ':'), 15, 0, ':')) AS RCRE_TIME
	,LCHG_USER_ID
	,CONVERT(DATETIME2, STUFF(STUFF(STUFF(LCHG_TIME, 9, 0, ' '), 12, 0, ':'), 15, 0, ':')) AS LCHG_TIME
	,TS_CNT
	,SCHM_CODE
	,MASTER_B2K_ID
	,FIXED_INSTALLMENT_AMT
	,NRML_INSTALLMENT_PCNT
	,INSTALLMENT_BASIS
	,CUMULATIVE_TOP_UP_PAID
	,BANK_ID
	,ADD_AMT2
	,1 AS ISACTIVE
	,1 AS ISLATEST
	,LEFT(FILE_NAME, 5) AS BNK_CODE
	,SUBSTRING(FILE_NAME,7,3) AS SOURCE_CODE
	,FILE_NAME
	,CONVERT(DATE,[INSERT_DTTM]) AS INSERT_DTTM
 FROM D360.STG_DEP_RENEWALHISTTABLE
